variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup color exploration / precise-object-edit. EDIT THE ATTACHED COMPLETE PACE HOMEPAGE MOCKUP. Do not redesign or add any content. White background and white form panel retained. Preserve P speech-bubble logo's white inner shape, recolor square only to theme primary. This is one COMPLETE desktop website visual concept, not a palette board; entire header, illustration/form, four services and footer visible; no browser frame or extra labels. Do not make all the art monochromatic: preserve natural skin, hair and neutral materials while replacing the former orange/yellow UI and art accent colors. Keep disabled inputs pale gray and labels dark, ensure high contrast and readable buttons. Do not change app functionality, claims, text, logo geometry, or add a new section. Never introduce a hero eyebrow or metrics. Implementable in existing Laravel Blade as HTML/CSS plus separate illustrations if later chosen.
